scope: R3-H1 validation, the one-off public-board correction, and a research-only GeoTIFF release. External facts are limited to the linked primary sources; local raster/model measurements are identified separately.

claims.claim: The official task maps geological faults that may be relevant to geothermal resources; the supplied known-fault map is incomplete and may contain inaccuracies, and test faults were separately expert-mapped.
claims.status: official competition page checked 2026-10-07; not a geothermal-vent label claim

claims.claim: The official public leaderboard fetch on 2026-10-07 showed 0.3774 at rank 1, 0.3195 at rank 7, and 0.2778 at rank 13 among visible rows.
claims.status: one-off dated participant-level observation; no filename/hash/upload-receipt mapping

claims.claim: The organizer's submission requirements include a single prediction band on the competition grid with values in [0,1]; the local written TIFF is additionally checked against the exact sample-template shape, CRS, affine transform, and bounds.
claims.status: official requirements read; byte-level checks are local and do not prove portal acceptance

claims.claim: Known USGS/INGENIOUS fault pixels are excluded from evaluation according to the organizer's staff clarification; predictions near those traces but outside the mask are not thereby known to be masked.
claims.status: official staff clarification; local geometric comparisons do not reveal hidden truth

claims.claim: The public metric rewards max-weighted proximity within a 300 m triangular kernel and uses alpha=0.2 and beta=0.8.
claims.status: official page; local implementation parity tested in tests/test_metric.py

claims.claim: Blum–Mitchell co-training relies on sufficient compatible views and a conditional-independence assumption in its theoretical setup; the R3 spatial proxy-error correlations are only a diagnostic and do not establish those assumptions.
claims.status: primary author-hosted paper; limitation explicitly retained

claims.claim: USGS's 1 m 3DEP DEM catalog identifies public-domain lidar-derived bare-earth DEM products and points to The National Map acquisition routes; exact coverage and downloaded bytes for this competition footprint were not checked.
claims.status: official catalog checked; footprint availability unverified

claims.claim: The 19-band local inventory describes band 12 as detrended elevation and band 19 as detrended-elevation slope; R3-H1 adds only two derived profile features to the existing surface-view feature list.
claims.section: Local input inventory and feature manifest
claims.status: measured from the restored owner-mirrored input; core input bytes are not organizer-authenticated

claims.claim: On the fixed four-fold, 80-pixel-buffer catalogue holdout, view B averaged 0.1946708778 DTI and view B plus the registered paired-profile features averaged 0.1948957893, a +0.0002249115 mean lift with positive paired lift in 2/4 folds. The preregistered gates required at least +0.005 and at least 3/4 positive folds; the candidate failed.
claims.status: recomputed against the registered local proxy task; not a public-score forecast or expert-label result

claims.claim: The R2 baseline arms refit exactly reproduced the published R2 holdout means; view B remained the strongest refitted local comparator at 0.1946708778.
claims.status: all six recorded mean deltas were zero; this establishes reproducibility of the local proxy comparison only

claims.claim: R3 proxy-negative view-error diagnostics used 2,093 spatial blocks and 4,201,273 held-out catalogue-zero predictions. Maximum absolute Pearson/Spearman correlation was 0.0711 for A versus B and 0.0805 for A versus B+H1; the frozen threshold was 0.60. The gate permitted a separate co-training diagnostic but does not prove view sufficiency or conditional independence.
claims.status: computed; catalogue-zero pixels are not verified geological absences

claims.claim: One optional exchange round was reported separately: A-to-B+H1 had +0.000794 mean DTI change in 2/4 folds; B+H1-to-A had -0.002259 mean change in 2/4 folds. Pseudo-labels were restricted to buffered training regions and did not change the primary candidate.
The R3 H1 candidate did not pass its local promotion gate, is not independently confirmed against expert-mapped hidden faults, and has no weekly-slot approval; no portal upload was performed.
claims.section: Promotion receipt and research-only artifact receipt
claims.status: local evidence; zero portal interactions by this implementation

claims.claim: Automated recurring DrivenData access remains disabled after review of the site's Terms of Use; the current board value is a dated one-off observation.
claims.section: Prohibited uses: automated access and unauthorized monitoring
claims.status: policy and implementation recorded in registry/source_policy.json; no scheduled scraping

claims.claim: The research-only R3-H1 GeoTIFF is one float32 band on the 3292 by 3730 sample grid, EPSG:32611, exact sample affine transform and bounds, raw values {0,1}, 37,654 positive cells, no non-finite values, matching internal mask, and byte/decoded hashes matching the receipts.
claims.status: local byte and raster checks passed; does not establish organizer portal acceptance

claims.claim: The candidate differs from each of 12 aligned accessible prior rasters, has 27,838 cells (73.9% of its 37,654-cell support) outside their comparison union, omits 221,770 prior-support cells, and is not the View A/View B literal union or matched-budget maximum-view union.
claims.status: research publication diagnostic passed; limited to supplied, accessible aligned inventory and not proof against inaccessible/private artifacts

claims.claim: The secondary whole-component A-only reasoning CSV contains 48 accepted components across four folds and one contextual geological-reasoning row per component; these are unverified candidates, not confirmed faults.
claims.status: 48 rows and 496 total exchanged pixels measured; hypotheses only

claims.claim: The local forensic comparison removes 2,545 off-catalogue pixels within 200 m from an owner-attributed 40,199-pixel base to a 37,654-pixel reference, adding none; the public score attribution and causal explanation remain unauthenticated.
claims.section: Nested sparse-raster byte comparison and dated public-board scope
claims.status: local file hashes and set differences measured; participant filename-to-score association is owner-reported and hidden labels are unavailable
